# Quotes.org.in

> A quotation library for discovering words by topic, author, mood and occasion, with visible source references, attribution notes and editorial review.

Read the source and edition linked to a quotation before relying on its exact wording. Keep the author, source, translation and attribution context with quoted text. A quotation's public-domain status does not automatically grant permission to reuse this site's original artwork.

Public collections contain reviewed records. Do not treat user-entered image-maker text as verified quotation content. Individual quotation pages provide reading and sharing context; topic collections are their canonical search destinations. Smaller author collections may remain outside search indexes while their reviewed coverage grows.

The links below lead to public HTML pages and XML discovery files. This guide does not grant additional crawling permissions, change robots.txt, or expose private editorial tools.

## Find quotations

- [Topics](https://quotes.org.in/topics): Browse quotation collections by subject.
- [Authors](https://quotes.org.in/authors): Find author records, quotations and source notes.
- [Source works](https://quotes.org.in/sources): Explore the books, speeches and other works behind the quotations.
- [Moods](https://quotes.org.in/moods): Browse by mood.
- [Occasions](https://quotes.org.in/occasions): Explore published occasion collections.
- [Quote of the day](https://quotes.org.in/quote-of-the-day): Read the selected daily quotation.
- [Search](https://quotes.org.in/search): Search quotations, authors and topics using the q query parameter.

## Attribution and editorial standards

- [About](https://quotes.org.in/about): What the library publishes and why sources matter.
- [Verification](https://quotes.org.in/verification): Wording, attribution, translation and rights checks.
- [Editorial policy](https://quotes.org.in/editorial-policy): Selection, review and publication standards.
- [Corrections](https://quotes.org.in/corrections): Public record of material corrections.
- [Copyright](https://quotes.org.in/copyright): Separate rights for quotation text and original artwork.
- [Contact](https://quotes.org.in/contact): Source questions, corrections, rights and licensing enquiries.

## Optional

- [Indian quotations](https://quotes.org.in/indian-quotes): Reviewed collections from Indian source traditions.
- [Hindi quotations](https://quotes.org.in/hindi-quotes): Hindi wording with English meanings and context.
- [Image maker](https://quotes.org.in/tools/quote-image-generator): Create an image from quotation text; custom input is unverified.
- [Sitemap index](https://quotes.org.in/sitemap-index.xml): Public sitemap discovery.
- [RSS feed](https://quotes.org.in/rss.xml): Published quotation feed.
- [Privacy](https://quotes.org.in/privacy): Data and measurement choices.
- [Terms](https://quotes.org.in/terms): Conditions of use.
